description: Parses RecentFileCache.bcf (Windows 7 / 2008 R2 program execution evidence).
usage: Parses RecentFileCache.bcf, which lists programs executed on Windows 7 and Server 2008 R2. Use it on those older systems as execution evidence.
limitation: RecentFileCache.bcf exists only on older Windows (7 and Server 2008 R2); newer systems use Amcache instead.

parameters.description: Directory to save json representation to.
Only show the filename being processed vs all output. Useful to speed up exporting to JSON and/or CSV.
